note: Weather (D-099). The host rolls the next state from weights (never the same one twice) and holds it for a random number of minutes; everyone blends to it over blend_seconds. Balanced: some weather most sessions, a storm about once an hour. The host can force a state from the pause menu (Auto puts the schedule back). Storm lightning every interval_s: near_chance of the time it targets a player standing outside (no roof within roof_check_m above): a warning on their screen and a glow on the ground, warn_s later it strikes offset_m from where they stood - damage within radius_m falls off from the centre, players under a roof are safe. Other strikes hit far_dist_m away (flash + thunder only; thunder arrives at sound_speed_mps). hearing: zombies' noise radius is multiplied by this in rain / storm / fog. storm_wind_add_mps: added to disc golf wind in a storm (capped at storm_wind_max_mps). rain: particles around the camera (none indoors).
